description: This file contains utility functions for high-order functions, including comparison, object manipulation, ID generation, and function debouncing, exported as a default module.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Returns a function that checks strict equality between itemA and another itemB.

methods.name: eq2
methods.description: Checks strict equality between two items.

methods.name: peq2
methods.description: Returns a function that compares a specific property of two objects for equality.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns a function that negates the result of another function.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Returns a function that performs logical AND on the results of two functions.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Returns a function that calls a specified method on an object with given arguments.

methods.name: uniqueId
methods.description: Generates a globally unique ID with an optional prefix.

methods.name: rect2bnd
methods.description: Converts a rect object to bounds, considering document scroll positions.

methods.name: invertObject
methods.description: Creates a new object with keys and values swapped from the input object.

methods.name: namespaceToCamel
methods.description: Converts a dot-separated namespace string to CamelCase with optional prefix.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Returns a debounced version of a function that delays execution until a pause in calls.
